info.name: Visualizing matrix norms
info.description: just a silly shader to understand matrix norms. i visualized a matrix M^(-1) being applied to the shape ||v||n <= 200, where ||v||n is the v's norm n=t/2. for n=2 the ellipse has eig(A*A) as axis and as n->∞ the parall. has eig(AA*) vertical to each side.
